title: unify-credential-presets-and-stream-primitive-across-sdks
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: customer signals and internal SDK parity work showed divergence in how Python/TS/Go SDKs express credential presets (refresh window, fallback chains) and a number of ergonomics gaps for streaming consumers (pull vs push primitives, cancel semantics). Motivation: converge on a compact, language-idiomatic 'CredentialPreset' surface plus a small 'stream primitive' layer that gives each SDK a stable, minimal contract for retries, heartbeat/keepalive, and cancel semantics rather than re-implementing rights/refresh logic per SDK. This reduces duplication, improves telemetry uniformity, and enables cross-SDK samples to behave identically. Changes (summary): introduced CredentialPreset model and presets registry with three modes (ephemeral-lease, rotating-fallback, delegated-pass-through) implemented in Python/TS/Go clients; added a StreamPrimitive interface/facade implemented as PullStream (py/ts) and StreamHandle (go) with identical observable semantics; centralized retry profiles used by streaming reconnect into a small shared spec and adapted each SDK to map to it; bumped SDK version pins: python->1.12.0, typescript->2.4.0, go->1.5.3; updated examples and migration guide. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-9876), [x] unit tests for each SDK, [x] integration tests for streaming handshake and reconnect, [x] sample app updated, [x] changelogs and migration notes. Commits: "add credential preset registry and spec (initial)"; "py: implement CredentialPreset + PullStream adapter + tests"; "ts: CredentialPreset + PullStream facade and examples"; "go: CredentialPreset mapping + StreamHandle + compat layer"; "align retry profiles and wire into streaming reconnect"; "bump versions and update changelogs". Files changed (high level): "sdks/python/redwood/credentials.py"; "sdks/python/redwood/streaming/pullstream.py"; "sdks/python/tests/test_credential_presets.py"; "sdks/typescript/src/cred/presets.ts"; "sdks/typescript/src/stream/pullStream.ts"; "sdks/typescript/test/stream-reconnect.spec.ts"; "sdks/go/cred/presets.go"; "sdks/go/stream/stream_handle.go"; "examples/credential-presets-migration.md"; "docs/sdk-migration/credential-presets.md"; "changelogs/python-1.12.0.md"; "changelogs/ts-2.4.0.md"; "changelogs/go-1.5.3.md". Testing & CI: unit-tests passed for all three SDKs; integration tests that exercise a simulated token refresh and reconnect passed after two iterations; linting applied in TS (prettier/eslint) and py (ruff/black) with a single style fix commit; e2e benchmarks flagged a transient latency regression on high-concurrency pullstream reconnect which was addressed by a small batching tweak and re-run. Review thread (high level): Miguel: requested clearer separation between CredentialPreset semantics and transport-level heartbeats; response: split the transport heartbeat into StreamPrimitive and left CredentialPreset pure (auth only) in second commit; Emily: asked for clearer migration docs and a shake-out of degenerate fallback chains; response: added examples and migration guide with recommended presets; Jordan: raised a concern about Go ergonomics around context cancellation mapping to PullStream cancel semantics, addressed by adding StreamHandle.Cancel and backing it with context.WithCancel under the hood. CI Checks: ["unit-tests (py): pass", "unit-tests (ts): pass", "unit-tests (go): pass", "integration/streaming: pass", "lint (ts): pass", "style (py): pass", "benchmarks: pass after fix"]. Merge: merged via squash (squash commit message: "unify credential presets + stream primitive across sdks") on 2026-02-19 after approvals from Miguel and Emily and green CI. Impact and follow-ups: migration notes published; recommended migration timeline of two release cycles for customers using custom credential adapters; follow-up ticket created (ENG-10123) to add telemetry keys for preset usage and to instrument reconnect hot paths.

review_comments: Miguel Torres: Please separate heartbeat/transport concerns from auth; this will keep CredentialPreset focused. Asha: Split into StreamPrimitive for transport heartbeat in commit 3.

Emily Chen: Migration doc needs an example for a rotating-fallback chain and a recommended safe default. Asha: Added migration example and recommended presets, see examples/credential-presets-migration.md.
Jordan Lee: Go cancel semantics look leaky — how does StreamHandle.Cancel map to context? Asha: Implemented Cancel backed by context.WithCancel and added unit tests in sdks/go/tests.
CI bot: integration/streaming initially failed on a race at reconnect; fixed by introducing a lightweight backoff and small batching window. Asha: re-ran CI and test passed.
release_notes: Added CredentialPreset API and presets registry across Python/TS/Go; introduced a StreamPrimitive facade for unified streaming cancel/heartbeat/reconnect semantics; improved streaming reconnect ergonomics and retry mapping; bumped SDK versions: python 1.12.0, typescript 2.4.0, go 1.5.3; migration guide included.
